evidence.title: Horizontal works begin on Datagrid's AI data centre campus in Makarewa
evidence.excerpt: Datagrid reports that horizontal works commenced on August 18, 2026 at its 49-hectare Makarewa AI data-centre campus, names HEB Construction, describes road, earthwork, bund and future foundation-platform scope, and says HEB teams are already on site.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 134574-byte content-decoded credential-free public response body
metadata.physical_status_scope: Supports only generic under_construction for the initial horizontal-works project as of 2026-08-18. It does not establish vertical construction, foundations completed, building erection, MEP installation, commissioning, energization, occupancy, completion, or operation.
metadata.supersession_review: Fresh review through 2026-09-06 found no authoritative completion, commissioning, energization, occupancy, or operation event for the initial horizontal-works project.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The reported 49 hectares describes site area only. No IT, gross-facility, grid, generation, demand, consumption, energy, rack, compute, or operating-capacity observation is emitted.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from an all-rights-reserved first-party project release; raw HTML and publisher media are not redistributed.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: No publisher image, satellite image, aerial image, computer vision, or analyst geolocation contributes.

evidence.title: Application - Datagrid New Zealand Partnership Limited
evidence.excerpt: The public resource-consent application identifies Datagrid New Zealand Partnership Limited, the Makarewa data-centre proposal at 342 and 370 Flora Road East and 63 Taylor Road, and its exact legal parcels and records of title.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 3842279-byte public PDF response body
metadata.identity_scope: The exact applicant, project type, Makarewa addresses, legal descriptions and records of title bridge the first-party construction update to the four authoritative LINZ core-campus parcel features.
metadata.geometry_scope: The four core parcels total about 49.2 hectares and correspond to the 49-hectare campus in the first-party update. The two additional DP 14668 parcels in the wider consent property are excluded because the application discusses separate access or haul-road use and they are not asserted as core campus land.
metadata.status_guardrail: The application supplies identity and parcel linkage only and creates no lifecycle observation.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from a public council record for which no affirmative open license was found; the PDF is not redistributed.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Application maps and drawings create no geometry here; only legal descriptions are used as exact lookup keys.

evidence.title: LINZ NZ Primary Parcels - four Datagrid Makarewa core-campus parcels
evidence.attribution: Crown copyright - Land Information New Zealand
evidence.excerpt: The current LINZ Primary Parcels service returns exactly the four title-matched core-campus parcels identified in the Southland District Council application.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 2855-byte content-decoded GeoJSON response body
metadata.geometry_derivation: Parse the four EPSG:4326 GeoJSON Polygon features, require the pinned feature ids, appellations and titles, dissolve their shared boundaries as one polygonal union, and serialize the resulting GeoJSON geometry with UTF-8, sorted keys and compact separators.
metadata.geometry_scope: Current authoritative cadastral union for four title-matched core-campus parcels. It is a campus locator, not an official project boundary, construction-work extent, building footprint, as-built survey, or the full six-parcel consent property.
metadata.source_accuracy_scope: LINZ describes nominal parcel accuracy as 0.1-1 metre in urban areas and 1-100 metres in rural areas; no project-specific metre accuracy is asserted.
metadata.license_scope: LINZ publishes the current Primary Parcels layer under CC BY 4.0. The extracted unmodified source coordinates are attributed; the deterministic union is an adaptation.
metadata.lifecycle_guardrail: Parcel currency and service timestamps create no lifecycle observation.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: No map click, basemap, satellite image, aerial image, computer vision, generic geocoder, or analyst drawing contributes.
